name: Tooltip
description: A delayed hover and keyboard-focus tooltip that fades and slides in from its side with a pointing arrow, measured placement and an automatic viewport flip. The demo shows a formatting toolbar with shortcut hints plus a labelled button.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA tooltip pattern: the bubble has role="tooltip" and the focusable trigger references it with aria-describedby while it is shown. Opens after a delay on mouse hover and immediately on keyboard focus (focus-visible only), stays open while the pointer is over the bubble, and closes on blur, pointer down, pointer leave or Escape. Icon-only triggers carry aria-label. The bubble is portaled to document.body only after mount and copies the --mf-* theme variables from its trigger. Under prefers-reduced-motion it only fades.

propsApi.name: content
propsApi.description: Tooltip text for the labelled trigger, or for children when provided.

propsApi.name: triggerLabel
propsApi.description: Label of the text trigger button in the default demo.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Custom trigger; replaces the demo toolbar. Its first focusable element receives aria-describedby.

propsApi.name: side
propsApi.description: Preferred side; flips to the opposite side when the viewport has no room.

propsApi.name: align
propsApi.description: Alignment along the trigger edge (clamped to the viewport).

propsApi.name: delayDuration
propsApi.description: Hover delay in milliseconds before the tooltip opens.

propsApi.name: skipDelayDuration
propsApi.description: After a tooltip closes, others open instantly within this window (ms).

propsApi.name: sideOffset
propsApi.description: Gap between trigger and tooltip in pixels.

propsApi.name: variant
propsApi.description: High-contrast, bordered surface, or accent-filled bubble.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color used by the accent variant.

propsApi.name: showShortcuts
propsApi.description: Show keyboard shortcut hints in the toolbar tooltips.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root.
